name: Uranian-Counterscarp

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by dust seas stretching to the horizon near the terminator.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
For traders, platinum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
